Judiciary Committee of the People's Majlis
Agenda

Committee: Judiciary Committee of the People's Majlis
Meeting: 12th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 12
Date: 20 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 12:30

1. Regarding the "Bill on Proceeds of Crime" and the "Bill to amend Law No. 12/2016 (Criminal Procedure Code)":
1.1. Setting a deadline for completing the review of the bills.
1.2. Deciding on advertising to seek public opinion on the bills.
1.3. Deciding on sending letters to seek comments from relevant institutions on the bills.

2. Extending the deadlines for completing work on bills submitted to the committee whose deadlines have expired:
2.1. Bill to amend Law No. 9/2014 (Penal Code of the Maldives), submitted on behalf of the government by the Member for Maafushi constituency, Hussain Riza Adam;
2.2. Bill to amend Law No. 22/2010 (Judicature Act of the Maldives), submitted by the Member for Holhudhoo constituency, Abdul Sattar Mohamed;
2.3. Bill to amend Law No. 9/2014 (Penal Code of the Maldives), submitted by the Member for South Galolhu constituency, Meekail Ahmed Nasym;
2.4. Bill to amend Law No. 11/2022 (Evidence Act), submitted on behalf of the government by the Member for Bilehdhoo constituency, Ahmed Aslam;
